title: Systems services that are not required must be disabled.
check_content:
Determine all of the systems services that are enabled on the system.

# svcs -a | grep online

Document all enabled services and disable any that are not required.
fixtext:
The Service Management profile is required:

Disable any other service not required. 

# pfexec svcadm disable [service name]
VulnDiscussion: Services that are enabled but not required by the mission may provide excessive access or additional attack vectors to penetrate the system.
